name: Zenodo REST API
description: CERN's general-purpose research repository: several million deposits of datasets, software releases, figures, posters and papers, each with a DOI. Because GitHub releases can be archived here automatically, it is also a large and searchable index of citable research software.

license.name: per-record; the metadata is CC0 and each deposit states its own licence

access.auth_note: reading public records needs no token; a free personal token raises the limit and is required to deposit

recipes.title: Find datasets on a topic with their download URLs
recipes.code:
curl -s 'https://zenodo.org/api/records?q=title:%22coral%20bleaching%22&type=dataset&size=3' | python3 -c "import json,sys
for h in json.load(sys.stdin)['hits']['hits']:
    print(h['doi'], h['title'])
    for f in h.get('files', []): print('   ', f['links']['self'])"

gotchas.trap: Records have both a versioned DOI and a concept DOI that always points at the newest version.
gotchas.fix: Cite the concept DOI for 'the dataset', the versioned DOI for reproducibility.

gotchas.trap: Anything can be deposited, so search results mix peer-reviewed data with slide decks and student projects.
gotchas.fix: Filter on type= and read resource_type before trusting a hit.
